summary: Preserve tracer-bullet slices and the wide-refactor exception; add discriminating acceptance, true blocking semantics, and resumable publication.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Test whether decomposition is needed and prefer the fewest independently useful slices.
deltas.reason: A small coherent change should not become a ticket bureaucracy.
deltas.tradeoff: Less parallelism when splitting would create coordination without value.

deltas.change: Give each ticket a demo/verification path and criterion that distinguishes the base from completion.
deltas.reason: Acceptance can otherwise be already true or depend on another ticket's unowned work.
deltas.tradeoff: More thought per ticket before publication.

deltas.change: Validate blocker graph and distinguish parent membership from execution dependency.
deltas.reason: Native sub-issue links do not mean blocked-by.
deltas.tradeoff: Some relationships need separate API operations.

deltas.change: Keep stable locator hints with provenance when they reduce rediscovery, without treating stale paths as requirements.
deltas.reason: A blanket path ban can throw away useful evidence.
deltas.tradeoff: Hints must be explicitly non-normative and refreshed by implementers.

deltas.change: Read back published tickets and resume partial publication using created IDs.
deltas.reason: A retry after partial success should not duplicate work items.
deltas.tradeoff: Publication has a small reconciliation step.

deltas.change: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation frontmatter while copying agents/openai.yaml explicit-only policy.
deltas.reason: The target is Codex packaging; its metadata preserves invocation intent and the bundled validator accepts the supported frontmatter.
deltas.tradeoff: This package is not a byte-identical Claude entrypoint.
